note: The VapourSynth runtime PushMPC's installer fetches for the mpv route (vsplugin, players-all.md R1), and the packages the vsplugin CI workflows use. Resolved and hashed on GitHub's runners by .github/workflows/pins.yml (2026-11-23). An entry whose version, URL or SHA-256 says TODO is never downloaded.

python.what: Python embeddable package (amd64), PSF licence; VapourSynth R82's wheel is cp312-abi3 (Python 3.12 or newer), 3.12.10 is the last 3.12 with Windows binaries

vapoursynth.what: VapourSynth portable (x64), LGPL-2.1; extracted over the Python folder; since R7x it carries the runtime as a wheel (wheel/*.whl), which is unpacked into lib/site-packages (where its vspipe.bat looks) and that folder added to the embeddable Python's ._pth

source.what: the source of the same tag, for the LGPL licence text that goes with the headers

activation.how: mpv (shinchiro builds) loads VSScript.dll from the DLL search path, so the folder holding VSScript.dll (R82: lib\site-packages\vapoursynth in the install folder) goes on the user's PATH (integrations/mpv/mpv-integration.ps1 -RuntimeOnPath, undone on uninstall). An existing VapourSynth install of the user's is used instead when one is found.
activation.check: mpv --vf=help lists 'vapoursynth' (the build has the filter) and VSScript.dll exists in the runtime folder

portableCi.what: VapourSynth R82 wheels from PyPI (self-contained: libvapoursynth, vspipe, the SDK headers) for the vsplugin-portable CI workflow on Linux and macOS (R3); never installed on a user's machine. Python 3.12+.

mpvForCi.what: shinchiro mpv (x86_64) for the vsplugin CI workflow only; never installed on a user's machine
